_doc: Session 15 (Sérgio Round 24), restructured Session 27 (R28-0c, D14/D15): THREE INTIMATE ROOMS THAT AGE, one shell. r1 = reinterp E1 (witness furniture out; spine door + record terminal). r2 = E2, HOMECOMING (D15): Daniel comes back to the SAME closed Room 1, aged — the walls do NOT open here (Sérgio: "at Era 2 the room ages but stays CLOSED"). r3 = T2 "the room OPENS, it does not explode" (moved from T1/E2): Room 1 (Daniel, gay) keeps its EXACT E1 walls/desk/front-wall distance; its side walls become DOORWAYS revealing Room 2 (west/Vera, lesbian) and Room 3 (east/Maya, trans) — two adjacent intimate bedrooms at the SAME scale, axis-aligned (90° only), each read at E1 desk-intimacy when the camera dollies in — AND Room 1 closes (Daniel "transferred") in the same state. r4 = E4: the focus is Room 3 (Maya = the trans room evolved — NOT a separate desk; ◆N3 TURN retargets here); windows go dark for good. Rooms built from ONE local bedroom template (scratchpad/gen_rooms.mjs) placed per room — bed on a side wall, door away from the bed, clean CRT. COLOR LAW: every hex from era1.json family.

New y0.83 puts cdStack's base back at 0.76, +0.12 from the old 0.71, matching the ~12cm S49 estimated by eye. teddyBox sits on the same old shelfBoard1 baseline and had the identical sink — flagged then, fixed now below (Session 55), since this session is already re-measuring this exact shelf. Session 55 ALSO moved x/z (1.98,0.9 → 2.02,0.62): its old z0.9 sat squarely in the middle of the three shelf tapes' new z-run (0.87-1.07 — the boombox's own Session 55 re-rotation widened its footprint and pushed the tapes into that space, see tapeA's _doc), and cdStack's box very nearly fully occluded tapeA from the seat (confirmed live: toggling cdStack.enabled off/on in-browser made tapeA go from invisible to visible). The shelf run only has ~0.3m free after the boombox — not enough for 3 legible tapes AND a 0.12m cdStack side by side — so cdStack moves to a second depth track instead, tucked behind the boombox (x2.02, near the bookcase's own back wall at x2.098, z0.62 matching the boombox's own z-centre) rather than competing for the same front row. mixtape._doc: Session 49 (finding 2): moved CLEAR of the cassette player and onto its shelf surface (full story on tapeA's own _doc below). Session 54: gave it `model: cassetteTape` too — a FIRST for a `props` override (every other model prop up to now was introduced via `add`, since Session 32's boombox override silently dropped `model`). Fixed properly this time, at the root: clusterMorph.ts's `foldTargets` now also copies `o.model` out of a `props` override, and `ClusterMorph.snapTo` re-spawns an EXISTING baseline id as the real mesh the first time its fold asks for one (mixtape was spawned as a box by era1room.ts's initial pass, long before this fold ever runs, so `spawnTarget`'s normal 'first spawn places itself' path never sees it). Kept as an override rather than a remove+add (the tapeA/tapeB pattern) on purpose: mixtape is both a belongings.json-eligible KEEPSAKE (its id must stay literally 'mixtape' for the ledger/kept-glow/click geometry) and a prop that RELOCATES at r3 (see that state's own props.mixtape) — a remove+add-new-id there would have raced the belongings 'kept freeze' (which re-asserts the r1 target under the ORIGINAL id) into showing two tapes at once, and tools/check-rooms.mjs's double-add check rejects remove+add of the SAME id within one state outright. `applyTarget`'s model branch now also re-applies position on every fold (previously model props were position-frozen after spawn), which is what lets r3's override actually move it. Session 55: `model` swapped `cassetteTape`→`cassetteTapeShelf` (data/room/models.json) — standing upright instead of lying flat, so it reads as a thing to pick up rather than a chip of debris. `pos` ALSO moved this round (x1.74→1.86, z1.09→1.07): the boombox's own Session 55 re-rotation changed its footprint from a thin vertical tower (x~1.78-1.94, barely into the shelf's z-run) to a wide landscape box (same x-depth, but z0.42-0.82) — at the tapes' old x1.74 they sat shallower than (visually 'in front of') the now-much-wider boombox instead of beside it; matching x1.86 puts every shelf object at the same depth, and mixtape's z nudges from 1.09 to 1.07 to keep clear of tapeB's new z0.97 slot (see tapeA/tapeB's own _doc for the full re-layout). Session 56: y0.766→0.709 — see boomboxModel's _doc, this whole shelf's `y0.76` was measured against the wrong surface; the real one is 0.057 lower. `yaw: 8` added too (same as tapeA/tapeB — a small turn toward the seat, see tapeA's _doc), which needed `clusterMorph.ts`'s `foldTargets` to also copy `yaw` out of a `props` override — the same silent-drop gap `model` had until Session 55, this time for a different field.

Session 49 (finding 2): the REAL cassette player, finally on the shelf. Session 32 tried to do this by putting `model: cassettePlayer` on an r1 OVERRIDE of the box-built `boombox` prop — but clusterMorph.ts's fold only copies color/pos/size out of `props` overrides, so the key was silently dropped and the shelf kept showing an anonymous dark box (the 418KB GLB was downloaded and never used). Overrides still cannot introduce a model; an ADD can (foldTargets passes def.model, and spawnTarget spawns it), which is how deskModel/chairModel/bookcaseModel already work. So the four box props are removed above and this replaces them. pos/size are Session 32's own measured values, kept verbatim: centered in the bookcase's rendered depth (x:[1.623,2.098]) with clearance on both shelf edges; `size` remains the fallback-box geometry if the GLB ever fails to load. Session 56: y0.76→0.703 — every shelf-1 prop's `y0.76` back to Session 32 turns out to have been measuring against the WRONG surface. Extracted the real bookcaseOpen.glb's own shelf-board vertices directly (`mesh.getPositions()` transformed by the entity's world matrix, bucketed by Y — no 3D viewer, same live-measurement discipline this pipeline has always used, just a level deeper than an AABB this time): the boards sit at y[0.190,0.247], [0.646,0.703], [1.102,1.159], [1.558,1.615] — four boards, five compartments. Cross-checked against book1 (era1.json, undisputed correct placement for 17+ sessions): its base is 1.10, matching board 3's top (1.102) almost exactly, confirming the method. The boombox/tapes/cdStack/teddyBox compartment is the one BELOW that (bounded by the board at 0.646-0.703), so its floor is 0.703, not 0.76 — every prop on this shelf was resting 5.7cm above its actual surface the whole time, which finally read as visibly wrong (Sérgio: 'the boombax is too up', 'a floating yellow tape') once the boombox stopped being a thin tower and started reading as a real object.

Spans both curtains (x -1.50 to -0.40, matching e_curtRod/w_curtRod's own span logic) just above their authored top (curtainLeft/Right pos.y 1.5 + half-height 0.55 = 2.05), same brown as the side rooms' rods and the shelf/desk timber already in this room. FLOATING → held (room-audit.mjs's 'hangs' rule: a prop whose base sits within 0.03 m of another prop's underside).

cdStack._doc: Session 71: this override said [1.98, 0.71, 3.45] — era1.json's ORIGINAL x and y plus 2.55 z. But r1 already corrects this prop to (2.02, 0.773) for two measured reasons (see r1's own _doc: the y put its base 0.063 m INSIDE the shelf board, and the x/z moved it off the tape run), and a later override replaces `pos` wholesale, so r3 silently reverted both. The fold's own hazard: an override further down the chain is not a delta, it is a replacement. Now r1's corrected position plus the shelf's +2.55 z.

teddyBox._doc: Session 71: LEFT BEHIND. r3 moves the bookcase from z 0.75 to 3.3 and gives book1/book3/cdStack matching overrides — teddyBox and rainbowDuck never got one, so from E3 on they hung in mid-air in the middle of the vacated room (measured: 0.683 m and 1.540 m of clear air beneath them, tools/room-audit.mjs FLOATING). Both now carry the shelf's own +2.55 z, which preserves each prop's exact relationship to its compartment rather than re-placing it by eye.

Every prop resting ON the desk (CRT, keyboard, mouse, folders) carries the same -0.09 z so the whole assembly stays together.

Session 74: THE PHONE GETS A REAL MODEL (build plan fixture list, item 4) — was a single untextured box, the exact fault the plan measured ('No `model` field on either. They are untextured boxes.'). No CC0 phone-shaped GLB exists in the local kit (assets/LICENSES.md) and this session had no way to fetch one, so it is built the CRT's own way — a real multi-part assembly, primitives not a mesh — using the new `parts` composite (era1room.ts/clusterMorph.ts): a dark glass body + a camera bump, under ONE id/entity so `app.ts`'s held-read toggle (`w_phoneDevice`, seat poses only in this session's file fence) keeps working unmodified — the whole assembly hides together when the phone comes to hand. `parts` positions are LOCAL offsets in this prop's own pre-yaw frame, same frame as `size`.

Session 74 — MAYA'S THINGS (the E4 room pass, build plan Stage 1 / S66's contract applied to her, per docs/reinterp/BUILD_QUEUE_LIVE.md and the session log). Present from r3 (E3) on, same convention as Vera's own belongings above: the three rooms are ONE building that ages 30 years in parallel, so Maya already lives here while the piece's attention is on Vera — the room does not become hers only when the story reaches E4. ~32 items, a scale not a quota (S66's own phrase); every colour reused from era1.json's family or already approved in this file, nothing invented. She is not Vera re-coloured: a different mix (a sketchbook and pens rather than a notepad; sneakers and a backpack by the door rather than slippers and a laundry basket; a floor cushion, not a throw pillow chair) and a different palette lean (mint/rose/tan rather than lavender/sage). Placement iterated in-engine against `node tools/room-audit.mjs` (see this session's log for before/after numbers).

e_crtScreen._doc: Session 74: THE CRT GOES DARK AND STAYS (build plan fixture list, item 3 — was blue, i.e. still reading as ON). #15151F is the same 'off' hex every other window/screen in this r4 block already goes to (windowPane/w_winPane/e_winPane above) — reused, not invented. This prop is spawned `emissive:true` (r3's own add), so an override here replaces its emissive colour directly (clusterMorph.applyTarget copies `color` straight onto the emissive channel for an emissive prop) — there is no separate 'off' switch in this data schema, so 'as dark as the rest of the dead glass in this room' is how off is expressed. Not deleted, not moved: the same machine across thirty years, finally off, still in the room.

add._doc: Session 74: THE PHONE GETS A REAL MODEL (fixture list item 4 — was a single untextured box; see w_phoneDevice's own _doc in r3 for why this is a primitive assembly rather than a GLB).
